title: ilex crenata f. luteovariegata
intro: Ilex crenata f. luteovariegata, commonly known as the 'Golden Variegated Japanese Holly', is a variant of the Ilex crenata plant, known for its distinctive golden-yellow variegated leaves. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving immune function, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ilex crenata f. luteovariegata, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
